claim: Two transit gateways, or one transit gateway and a Cloud WAN core network edge (CNE), can have 1 peering attachment between them, and this quota is not adjustable.
question: How many peering attachments can exist between two transit gateways?

values.spoken: one peering attachment between two transit gateways

qualifiers.scope: peering attachments between two transit gateways or between one transit gateway and a Cloud WAN core network edge (CNE)
